U0.name: Penyimpanan Berbasis Konten (MCard CAS)
U0.description: Lapisan data atomik yang tidak dapat dipecah lagi; unit kebenaran mendasar sebelum ada proses.

DropletAtom.name: Atom Tetesan Air
DropletAtom.desc: Tetesan air individual yang jatuh dari pancuran bambu; kejadian fisik diskrit pertama dari kontinum air alam semesta.
DropletAtom.metaphor: Satu butir beras di tampah bambu atau satu tetes embun pagi.

NaturalNumber.name: Bilangan Asli (ℕ)
NaturalNumber.desc: Indeks hitungan diskrit yang bertambah secara teratur dari titik awal kosong (Zero).
NaturalNumber.metaphor: Menaruh batu kerikil satu per satu ke dalam kaleng kosong.

ContentId.name: Pengidentifikasi Konten (CID)
ContentId.desc: Sidik jari kriptografis (hash SHA-256 / BLAKE3) yang menjamin catatan tidak bisa dimanipulasi.
ContentId.metaphor: Cap segel adat yang tak terhapuskan pada prasasti desa.

ThermalQuantum.name: Kuantum Termal
ThermalQuantum.desc: Satuan energi fisik dan panas Landauer yang dibutuhkan untuk mencatat dan menghapus informasi.
ThermalQuantum.metaphor: Keringat dan kehangatan telapak tangan saat bekerja menampi beras.

U1.name: Transisi Linear & Mesin Keadaan (PCard CPN)
U1.desc: Lapisan proses dinamis yang mengubah satu keadaan menjadi keadaan berikutnya.

ClepsydraTick.name: Detak Jam Air (ADC)
ClepsydraTick.desc: Pengubah Aliran Kontinu menjadi Sinyal Diskrit (Analog-to-Digital Converter).
ClepsydraTick.metaphor: Bunyi 'tik!' saat air penuh dan menumpahkan bilah bambu jungkit.

PeanoSuccessor.name: Penerus Peano (Succ)
PeanoSuccessor.desc: Operasi penambahan satu satuan hitungan tanpa melompati urutan.
PeanoSuccessor.metaphor: Melangkah tepat satu jengkal ke depan.

DemonObservation.name: Pengamatan Maxwellian Demon
DemonObservation.desc: Aksi sadar pengamat yang membedakan tetesan dengan mengorbankan sebagian energi.
DemonObservation.metaphor: Penjaga pintu air yang fokus menyaring sampah ranting dari aliran sungai.

U2.name: Verifikasi Kriptografis & Bukti Batas (VCard Proof)
U2.desc: Lapisan penjaga kebenaran dan hukum kekekalan; memastikan sistem adil dan seimbang.

LaminarConservationGate.name: Gerbang Kekekalan Aliran Laminar
LaminarConservationGate.desc: Batas ketenangan: mengamati dengan ritme stabil (~1 detik) menurunkan entropi sistem.
LaminarConservationGate.metaphor: Aliran air tenang yang menyuburkan petak sawah tanpa merusak pematang.

LandauerBoundProof.name: Bukti Batas Landauer
LandauerBoundProof.desc: Kepastian termodinamika bahwa memencet terburu-buru menimbulkan gesekan panas berlebih.
LandauerBoundProof.metaphor: Gesekan telapak tangan yang memerah panas jika digosok terlalu kencang.

PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.name: Resi Pembukuan Berpasangan Pacioli
PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.desc: Bukti kekekalan bahwa air yang keluar dari bilah bambu sama persis dengan air yang masuk ke lumbung desa.
PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.metaphor: Pembagian air Subak: debit masuk wajib sama persis dengan debit keluar.

U3.name: Jala Terdistribusi & Tindak Tutur (Satori Speech Acts)
U3.desc: Lapisan komunikasi dan sinestesia; interaksi multi-agen dan umpan balik suara.

ElderWarningAct.name: Petuah Tetua Desa
ElderWarningAct.desc: Tindak tutur arahan dan peringatan moral agar pengamat tidak serakah atau panik.
ElderWarningAct.metaphor: Nasihat sesepuh adat di balai desa saat musim tanam tiba.

AuditoryPulseAct.name: Detak Audio Sinestetik
AuditoryPulseAct.desc: Umpan balik suara plink yang membuat telinga merasakan penurunan entropi.
AuditoryPulseAct.metaphor: Denting tetesan air di tempayan tanah liat hening.

MilestoneChimeAct.name: Harmoni Gamelan Milestone
MilestoneChimeAct.desc: Perayaan musikal saat kelipatan sepuluh tetesan berhasil dicatat secara sah.
MilestoneChimeAct.metaphor: Tabuhan gong penutup pada upacara syukur panen.

U4.name: Membran Antarmuka Manusia-Mesin (Membrane UI)
U4.desc: Lapisan presentasi visual dan tombol taktil yang dapat disentuh langsung oleh pembelajar.

WaterClockStack.name: Tumpukan Kartu Jam Air MCard
WaterClockStack.desc: Wadah visual retro bergaya MCard tempat seluruh simulasi berlangsung.
WaterClockStack.metaphor: Pondok bambu tempat alat ukur air diletakkan rapi.

CatchDropTrigger.name: Tombol Tangkap Tetesan
CatchDropTrigger.desc: Pemicu taktil instan (<100ms) untuk merekam jatuhnya air secara sadar.
CatchDropTrigger.metaphor: Menadah air sejuk dengan telapak tangan tepat pada waktunya.

ThermodynamicGauge.name: Termometer Termodinamika
ThermodynamicGauge.desc: Pengukur visual sisa energi pengamat dan kenaikan suhu sistem.
ThermodynamicGauge.metaphor: Indikator panas air rebusan yang siap mendidih.

U5.name: Lingkar Pembelajaran Meta-Sirkuler (Loop Γ)
U5.desc: Lapisan refleksi kognitif tertinggi; penyempurnaan diri dan kenikmatan belajar tanpa rasa takut.

GASingFlowState.name: Kondisi Alir GASing (Flow State)
GASingFlowState.desc: Keseimbangan sempurna antara tantangan dan keahlian pembelajar (Gampang, Asyik, Menyenangkan).
GASingFlowState.metaphor: Keheningan batin seorang dalang wayang yang menyatu dengan irama gamelan.

EpistemicFitness.name: Kebugaran Epistemik
EpistemicFitness.desc: Ukuran kecerdasan sistem: perbandingan antara keputusan jernih dan kebisingan.
EpistemicFitness.metaphor: Kebersihan air mata air pegunungan yang tidak tercemar lumpur.

KenoticEmptySchema.name: Skema Kosong (Kenosis)
KenoticEmptySchema.desc: Sikap mengosongkan asumsi agar pikiran siap menerima kebenaran baru apa pun bentuknya.
KenoticEmptySchema.metaphor: Cangkir kosong yang siap diisi air teh segar nan harum.

U0.name: Content-Addressable Storage (MCard CAS)
U0.description: Irreducible atomic state data layer; raw immutable existential witnesses prior to transformation.

DropletAtom.name: Droplet Atom
DropletAtom.desc: Individual droplet event pinched off from continuous bamboo sluice; fundamental discrete event.
DropletAtom.metaphor: A single grain of sand or single drop of morning dew.

NaturalNumber.name: Natural Number (ℕ)
NaturalNumber.desc: Monotonically increasing discrete index initialized at Zero.
NaturalNumber.metaphor: Placing pebbles one by one into an empty container.

ContentId.name: Content Identifier (CID)
ContentId.desc: Cryptographic content hash (SHA-256 / BLAKE3) guaranteeing tamper-evident immutability.
ContentId.metaphor: An indelible wax seal stamped onto an ancient treaty.

ThermalQuantum.name: Thermal Quantum
ThermalQuantum.desc: Physical unit of Landauer energy and dissipation heat required to observe and erase information.
ThermalQuantum.metaphor: The thermal warmth radiating from physical work.

U1.name: Linear Transitions & State Machines (PCard CPN)
U1.desc: Dynamic computational stratum executing state transformations across discrete time steps.

ClepsydraTick.name: Water Clock Tick (ADC)
ClepsydraTick.desc: Analog-to-Digital Converter collapsing fluid accumulation into discrete pinch-off event.
ClepsydraTick.metaphor: The crisp click of an escapement gear turning by one tooth.

PeanoSuccessor.name: Peano Successor (Succ)
PeanoSuccessor.desc: Unit increment operator advancing count without skipping intermediate positions.
PeanoSuccessor.metaphor: Stepping forward by exactly one pace.

DemonObservation.name: Maxwell's Demon Observation
DemonObservation.desc: Conscious discriminatory act expending observer energy to record a verified tick.
DemonObservation.metaphor: A watchful lock keeper directing flow through canal gates.

U2.name: Cryptographic Verification & Proof Boundaries (VCard Proof)
U2.desc: Conservation law boundaries and Hoare logic correctness gates guaranteeing systemic invariants.

LaminarConservationGate.name: Laminar Conservation Gate
LaminarConservationGate.desc: Resonance condition: steady observation rhythm (~1s cadence) guarantees negative entropy dissipation (ΔH < 0).
LaminarConservationGate.metaphor: Calm, smooth water flow nourishing crops without eroding banks.

LandauerBoundProof.name: Landauer Bound Proof
LandauerBoundProof.desc: Thermodynamic proof that high-frequency clicking dissipates destructive friction heat (Q ≥ kB T ln 2).
LandauerBoundProof.metaphor: The hot friction of rubbing hands together too violently.

PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.name: Pacioli Double-Entry Receipt
PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.desc: Conservation witness verifying debited reservoir matches credited communal cistern.
PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.metaphor: Double-entry bookkeeping balancing debits and credits to zero error.

U3.name: Distributed Mesh & Speech Acts (Satori Speech Acts)
U3.desc: Agentic communication and synesthetic audio streams connecting actors across space and time.

ElderWarningAct.name: Village Elder Warning Act
ElderWarningAct.desc: Directive speech act counseling the operator against greed, panic, and cognitive burnout.
ElderWarningAct.metaphor: The calm counsel of an experienced navigator during a storm.

AuditoryPulseAct.name: Synesthetic Audio Pulse Act
AuditoryPulseAct.desc: Real-time acoustic feedback rendering entropy reductions audible as clear water plinks.
AuditoryPulseAct.metaphor: The resonant ring of a drop hitting a still water basin.

MilestoneChimeAct.name: Milestone Gamelan Chime Act
MilestoneChimeAct.desc: Harmonic multi-frequency chime celebrating verified decade multiples of counted tokens.
MilestoneChimeAct.metaphor: A ceremonial temple gong sounding across the valley.

U4.name: Human-Machine Interaction Surface (Membrane UI)
U4.desc: Omnichannel presentation surface providing tactile controls and immediate visual feedback.

WaterClockStack.name: MCard Water Clock Stack Viewport
WaterClockStack.desc: Retro MCard canvas housing physical simulation, meters, and event logs.

CatchDropTrigger.name: Catch Drop Trigger
CatchDropTrigger.desc: Sub-100ms low-latency tactile button capturing drops at the crest of meniscus detachment.
CatchDropTrigger.metaphor: Cupping hands under a cool waterfall at the precise moment of flow.

ThermodynamicGauge.name: Thermodynamic Dual Gauge
ThermodynamicGauge.desc: Twin physical meters displaying observer energy reserve and accumulated system heat.
ThermodynamicGauge.metaphor: A precision boiler steam gauge monitoring pressure and fuel.

U5.name: Meta-Circular Continuous Learning Stratum (Loop Γ)
U5.desc: Highest cognitive reflection layer monitoring learning feedback and sovereign intelligence formation.

GASingFlowState.name: GASing Flow State
GASingFlowState.desc: Cognitive resonance equilibrium eliminating friction between student intention and tool response.
GASingFlowState.metaphor: An archer whose breath, bow, and target merge into a single stillness.

EpistemicFitness.name: Epistemic Fitness Metric
EpistemicFitness.desc: Systemic intelligence score measuring ratio of coherent laminar observations to turbulent noise.
EpistemicFitness.metaphor: The clarity of high alpine mountain springs untainted by sediment.

KenoticEmptySchema.name: Kenotic Empty Schema
KenoticEmptySchema.desc: Self-emptying epistemological posture welcoming any well-formed data without prior prejudice.
KenoticEmptySchema.metaphor: An empty vessel ready to receive fresh mountain rain.

meta.latticeTitle: CLM 類型格（Type Lattice）：第 01 章

U0.name: 內容定址靜態儲存層（MCard CAS）
U0.description: 不可約簡的原子級資料本體層；在任何運算前已確鑿存在的客觀見證對。

DropletAtom.name: 水滴本體原子
DropletAtom.desc: 自竹筒連續水流中因表面張力夾斷而生的獨立物理水滴，為離散事件之始。
DropletAtom.metaphor: 竹篩上的一粒飽滿稻穀，或晨曦竹尖凝結的一滴甘露。

NaturalNumber.name: 自然數（ℕ）
NaturalNumber.desc: 自空無起始、嚴格單調遞增的離散計數索引。
NaturalNumber.metaphor: 將算籌一根一根置入空竹筒中。

ContentId.name: 內容識別碼（CID）
ContentId.desc: 基於 SHA-256 / BLAKE3 雜湊之不可篡改指紋，確保帳本記錄萬世不移。
ContentId.metaphor: 青銅鼎上銘刻的族徽與銘文印記。

ThermalQuantum.name: 熱力學量子
ThermalQuantum.desc: 蘭道爾極限下擦除或記錄一比特資訊所必耗之物理能量與熵變。
ThermalQuantum.metaphor: 農夫在田間揮鎬勞作時額頭滲出的微溫汗水。

U1.name: 線性躍遷與動態狀態機（PCard CPN）
U1.desc: 執行時間步躍遷與狀態轉換之動態運算層（Polynomial Functor）。

ClepsydraTick.name: 漏刻鐘擺滴答（ADC 轉換）
ClepsydraTick.desc: 將連續類比流體累積轉換為離散脈衝之模數轉換器（Analog-to-Digital Converter）。
ClepsydraTick.metaphor: 竹節水滿自傾、敲擊青石發出的清脆「嗒」聲（添水 / Shishi-odoshi）。

PeanoSuccessor.name: 皮亞諾後繼算子（Succ）
PeanoSuccessor.desc: 嚴格將當前計數推遞至下一單位的後繼函數（n ↦ n + 1）。
PeanoSuccessor.metaphor: 棋盤上下定不移的一著前進。

DemonObservation.name: 馬克士威妖觀測躍遷
DemonObservation.desc: 觀測者消耗本體儲備能量、以主動識別水滴的狀態轉移過程。
DemonObservation.metaphor: 水閘巡守人在激流前凝神定格每一朵浪花。

U2.name: 密碼學驗證與邊界證明（VCard Proof）
U2.desc: 守恆定律與霍爾三元組 {P} C {Q} 之檢驗邊界，杜絕系統虛擬幻覺與債務膨脹。

LaminarConservationGate.name: 層流諧振守恆閘門
LaminarConservationGate.desc: 穩定節律（約1秒間隔）下觸發之熵減閘門，確保系統維持層流負熵（ΔH < 0）。
LaminarConservationGate.metaphor: 心平氣和時如鏡湖止水，波瀾不驚卻潤澤萬物。

LandauerBoundProof.name: 蘭道爾極限證明
LandauerBoundProof.desc: 證明日誌過載高頻點擊時，資訊抹除必然釋放劇烈熱耗散之物理定律。
LandauerBoundProof.metaphor: 雙手劇烈摩擦必然灼熱生痛。

PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.name: 帕喬利複式記帳收據
PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.desc: 證明竹筒流出之水滴總量與村落水窖收納量嚴格相等的守恆收據。
PacioliDoubleEntryReceipt.metaphor: 天平兩端：出入平衡，分毫不差。

U3.name: 分散式網絡與言語行為（Satori Speech Acts）
U3.desc: 多代理人協作、儀式性發言與聽覺微波反饋之共鳴層。

ElderWarningAct.name: 村落長者警世言語行為
ElderWarningAct.desc: 長者發布之指令性與警示性言語行為，提醒觀測者勿陷於躁進焚身或怠惰滅頂。
ElderWarningAct.metaphor: 族中尊長於村廟晨鐘後的諄諄訓誡。

AuditoryPulseAct.name: 聽覺波紋脈衝行為
AuditoryPulseAct.desc: 以 Web Audio 即時合成之水滴微漾聲，將抽象的熵減化為清冽聽覺感受。
AuditoryPulseAct.metaphor: 清泉滴入石臼的幽咽空靈。

MilestoneChimeAct.name: 里程碑磬樂諧振行為
MilestoneChimeAct.desc: 每逢十進位水滴驗證通過時響起之泛音和弦，強化集體秩序達成感。
MilestoneChimeAct.metaphor: 宗廟編磬齊鳴，慶賀秋收祭典圓滿。

U4.name: 人機互動介面薄膜層（Membrane UI）
U4.desc: 人機交界之實體化薄膜；賦予學習者觸手可及的操縱感與沉浸式儀表板。

WaterClockStack.name: MCard 水鐘卡片視窗
WaterClockStack.desc: 承載物理流體模擬、實時儀表與歷史日誌的復古風格 MCard 容器。
WaterClockStack.metaphor: 工匠精心打造的儀器木盒。

CatchDropTrigger.name: 捕獲水滴觸發按鈕
CatchDropTrigger.desc: 反應延遲小於100毫秒的實體按鈕，讓觀測者在水滴飽滿瞬間定格捕捉。
CatchDropTrigger.metaphor: 陶壺注水，恰至壺沿時輕輕收手。

ThermodynamicGauge.name: 熱力學雙聯溫度儀
ThermodynamicGauge.desc: 直觀展示觀測者能量消耗與系統熵溫累積之擬物化刻度表。
ThermodynamicGauge.metaphor: 鍋爐上的銅製壓力與水溫聯動計。

U5.name: 元循環持續學習躍遷層（Loop Γ）
U5.desc: 最高階之認知自省層；維繫 GASing 心流與無假定虛心狀態。

GASingFlowState.name: GASing 心流共振態（Flow State）
GASingFlowState.desc: 學習者在簡單（Gampang）、趣味（Asyik）、享受（Menyenangkan）間達成的心智共鳴狀態。
GASingFlowState.metaphor: 庖丁解牛，神凝於刃，遊刃有餘。

EpistemicFitness.name: 認識論適應度指標
EpistemicFitness.desc: 評估系統信噪比：以層流純度對比無序擾動之智慧純淨度度量。
EpistemicFitness.metaphor: 高山雪水之清澈度，澄澈見底而無纖塵。

KenoticEmptySchema.name: 空無模式（Kenosis 自我虛空）
KenoticEmptySchema.desc: 不預設立場的歸零本心，以極小假定包容萬千真實數據的開放容器。
KenoticEmptySchema.metaphor: 虛堂懸鏡，物來則照，物去則空。
